_comment: Base config of the opencode arm. run.sh adds small_model = the cell's model:
otherwise the title agent calls a SECOND model (google/gemini-3.8-flash by
default), and it cannot be disabled — the run hangs.
All traffic goes to hallmark-gw — the only host reachable from the hm-int network.
The real OpenRouter key never enters the container: the gateway sets Authorization.
permission.task = allow — subagents are ALLOWED as part of opencode; pi has no
subagents — a declared difference between the harnesses, not a defect of the pair.
webfetch/websearch/skill = deny: the bare tier had no web, an arm with web is not a pair.
cfg2: external_directory = allow and experimental.continue_loop_on_deny = true. The
default (external_directory: ask) is answered with a denial in headless mode, and on a
denial opencode ENDED the agent loop without an answer (scored as zeros). Leaving /work
is now allowed (outside it the container holds only the image), and any remaining
denial (doom_loop: ask) no longer ends the loop. Arm version: harness_version
